default/30590.htm.text: Khavatari Rosheek: What brings you to this desolate snowfield, young traveler? I am Rosheek, who trains Kabart, the traditional martial art of the Orcs. As the god Paagrio has taught us, we must continuously make an effort to strengthen ourselves above all the other creatures that live. I have stay…

Q00415_PathOfTheOrcMonk/30590-01.html.text: Khavatari Rosheek: It's a fledgling sent by Gantaki! How dare you disturb my meditation ... I don't want to associate with someone with no skill! Go catch the kasha bear with your bare hands! Then, pull out five claws and bring them back in this pouch! Until you finish this task, don't think of com…

Q00415_PathOfTheOrcMonk/30590-02.html.text: Khavatari Rosheek: Didn't I tell you not to come back before you caught the kasha bear and pulled out five claws? Do not disturb my discipline -- just go hunt the bear! And take heed! If you use any other weapon besides your bare fists or combat weapons, you are disqualified!
